WHAT IS FANTASY 5?

Fantasy 5 is a draw game where the goal is to match your numbers to the numbers selected in the drawing to win cash prizes.

Ticket Price: $1

Drawings: Mondays through Sundays

 

WHAT IS EXTRA!?

EXTRA! is a separate game that can be added onto your Fantasy 5 ticket and can be played instantly. Playing a $1 EXTRA! gives you a chance to win up to $250, and playing a $2 EXTRA! gives you a chance to win up to $500.

By playing, you will receive five EXTRA! numbers* on your ticket and if any of them match your numbers for Fantasy 5, you win the prize amount shown next to the matched EXTRA! number**. If you match more than one number, you win the prize amount for each one of those matches as well.

*EXTRA! numbers are not associated with draw numbers.
**The Doubler feature does not apply to EXTRA!

Additional Cost: $1 or $2 per game

Applies To: All prizes

Overall Odds: 1 in 3.8


HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS AND PLAY

How to Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Fantasy 5 tickets cost $1 per game and are available for purchase at the counter of Arizona Lottery Retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Numbers

There are two ways to choose numbers:

To let the computer select the numbers for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.

To choose your own numbers, fill out a selection slip or tell the cashier which five numbers you would like to select (1 - 41).

Play for Even More Prizes

Add on a $1 or $2 EXTRA!, a separate game played on your Fantasy 5 ticket, for a chance to win $250 or $500 instantly.

Doubler Feature - Approximately one in every 10 tickets will be designated a DOUBLER at no additional cost, which doubles all non-jackpot prizes*! Just look for the DOUBLER symbol on your ticket.

*The Doubler feature does not apply to EXTRA!

How to Check the Winning Numbers

You can find the winning numbers online, at an Arizona Lottery retailer or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

ABOUT WINNING

How to Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

FANTASY 5 FAQS

What are the odds of winning Fantasy 5?

The overall odds of winning a cash prize are approximately 1 in 9.62.

When are Fantasy 5 drawings held?

Drawings are held Monday through Sunday evenings.

How often can I play my numbers?

You can play your numbers for up to 12 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the Number of Draws box on your selection slip.

How long do I have to claim a prize?

For draw game tickets, 180 days from the date of the draw. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

What happens if multiple people win the jackpot?

The players will share the jackpot in equal amounts.

 

*Sales stop on draw nights at 6:59 p.m. Arizona time.

**Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

***Odds of winning a prize with EXTRA! vary.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
